narrationScript: Welcome to Cohortia's Introduction to Algorithms and Efficiency. This chapter will define what an algorithm is, exploring its role as a precise set of instructions for computers. We'll then dive into why efficiency is crucial in computer science, learning to measure an algorithm's performance using Big O notation. You'll understand best, worst, and average-case scenarios, applying these concepts to the fundamental linear search algorithm. By the end, you'll not only grasp how algorithms work but also how to critically evaluate their real-world performance, a vital skill for any programmer.
